name: Archer Park Station and Steam Tram Museum

name: Botanic Gardens

name: Capricorn Spire

objection: Minor memorial (rule 3); duplicate of Cook's Landing Place.

name: Causeway Lake
objection: Bare listing with no description; may be a local recreation lake.

name: Dreamtime Cultural Centre
objection: Weekday-only hours and one counted source; centre's state of operation not verified.

name: Headland Walk
objection: Short generic walk, possibly part of the Cook's landing area.

name: Koorona Crocodile Farm
objection: Wikivoyage is lukewarm on value; operator-style attraction; operating status unverified.

name: Mount Archer
objection: Single counted source; short viewpoint visit unless walks are added.

name: Mount Etna Caves National Park
objection: Access is restricted, public visit is not simple; sits beside Capricorn Caves; park access can be closed for bats.

name: Rockhampton Heritage Village
objection: One counted source; volunteer-run, opening may be limited.

name: Rockhampton Zoo
objection: Local council zoo of modest size; one counted source.

name: Singing Ship
objection: A memorial (rule 3) and short stop.

name: Wreck Point
objection: Bare listing, likely a short coastal lookout.

name: Agnes Water, Queensland
objection: Town locality rather than a specific place; the beach may be better named as the spot.

name: Beautiful Betsy
objection: For: a distinctive wreck, quirky and named. Against: remote 4WD and a long walk in Kroombit Tops, one non-counted source, and may be a part of the park spot.

name: Big Bulls
objection: No counted source; short stop.

name: Boyne Valley, Queensland
objection: For: a named scenic region a guide recommends. Against: a rural locality, not a place; the draws are small towns, an historical cottage open by appointment and a rail trail.

name: Calliope River Historical Village
objection: Markets are annual events and are not counted; the village open daily is. Hours may be dated.

name: Cooee Bay
objection: Small beach beside Yeppoon; the visitor-source evidence is thin and some results were aggregators. The Wreck Point lookout may be the real draw.

name: Customs House, Rockhampton
objection: Mostly an exterior and a visitor centre; a short stop, though a guide singles it out by name. Could be folded into a riverside heritage walk.

name: Facing Island
objection: Remote, 4WD only on the island and basic camping; casual visitors need a ferry and self-sufficiency.

name: Gladstone Regional Art Gallery and Museum
objection: Council-run gallery in a civic building, but it is open and a named attraction, not an office.

name: Glenmore Homestead, Rockhampton
objection: For: an 1850s slab homestead with a log cabin. Against: register source only, interior seen from the verandah, and the Rockhampton Heritage Village covers the same era.

name: Joseph Banks Top Lookout
objection: Short roadside lookout, Wikipedia only.

name: Keppel Sands, Queensland
objection: A small retiree village; the beach is the draw, so rename and pin to the beach, not the town.

name: Kershaw Gardens
objection: Cyclone Marcia damaged it in 2015 and current state is unconfirmed; a local garden beside two stronger Rockhampton gardens.

name: Kinka Beach, Queensland
objection: Quiet locality beach; a second-tier stop, which the rules keep.

name: Mount Archer, Queensland
objection: Wikipedia entry is a suburb; coordinates sit on the summit area so placement is fine. Park pages return 403 to scripts (UNRESOLVED, not evidence against).

name: Mount Morgan railway station
objection: The station as a building is a heritage-register entry; the draw is the museum and the visit centre inside, so the name must change.

name: Mount Morgan, Queensland
objection: Much of the draw is its two small museums, listed separately; the town is a locality and a ~40 min drive from Rockhampton.

name: Number 7 Dam
objection: Council recreation park; the mine itself is closed and a visitor may find it a short stop.

name: Queensland Alumina Limited
objection: Industrial site; tours are scheduled weekly, may have lapsed, and the lookout is a short stop. Case for: unusual industrial tourism a guide names.

name: Rockhampton
objection: Judged as a city it is a base rather than one sight; its attractions are separate spots.

name: Rockhampton Museum of Art
objection: Council-run civic gallery, but it is a purpose-built gallery open to all, not a civic office.

name: Rules Beach, Queensland
objection: For: an official beach and camping area. Against: high-clearance 4WD or boat only, mostly a camping and holiday park destination, and the locality sits near the Bundaberg border.

name: Seventeen Seventy, Queensland
objection: Overlaps the Cook's Landing and Wreck Point spots in shard 1; small town.

name: Tannum Sands, Queensland
objection: Beach town with ordinary surf beach; the Millennium Esplanade candidate is the same place.

name: Wilson Island
objection: For: a named reachable cay, which the brief says to keep. Against: one source, permit and boat needed, and the parent park pages are blocked (UNRESOLVED).

name: Yeppoon
objection: Mainly a base; the sights are the beaches and islands around it.

name: Tondoon Botanic Gardens
objection: Local council garden; mainly locals use it.

name: East Shores Parklands
objection: For: central waterfront stop. Against: playground and park for locals; overlaps Gladstone Marina precinct.

name: Auckland Point Lookout
objection: Short stop of 15-30 minutes.

name: Gladstone Marina and Spinnaker Park
objection: Fairly ordinary recreation park; its value is ferry access.

name: Canoe Point
objection: A short esplanade stop; may be only a local foreshore park.

name: TurtleWay
objection: A paved path; the visit is cycling not sightseeing.

name: Lake Awoonga
objection: Single counted source; sparse facilities.

name: Curtis Island National Park
